notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds incl. School Nutrition are in the governmental funds statement (Exhibit III, Total Governmental Funds column), so business_type is null. Balance sheet is the Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (governmental activities only, no liabilities). Receipts: statement lines for Local and County Receipts are split using the fund schedules (split_from, computed); Local Receipts in the statement includes Special Building property tax credit 70,125.54 and School Nutrition interest 108.06. Transfers in/out 265,000 are General Fund to School Nutrition 185,000 and Activity 80,000 (Schedule M p29); no hidden transfers inside spending lines. Depreciation Fund 'Allocation from General Fund' 6,056.78 is printed as a receipt with no matching General Fund outflow (decision_needed). Detail: General Fund spending taken from Schedule M (object by program, includes 8000 Transfers as other financing, signed); Schedule B (function only) not recorded to avoid double counting; Schedule A receipts recorded. Object mapping: Purchased and Other Property Services mapped to professional/contract services; Property to equipment purchases; Miscellaneous to miscellaneous expenditure (review). Zero-actual lines with budget only were omitted except a few printed 0.00. Schedules A-1, N and O (county treasurer detail) are reconciling/duplicate and not recorded. Budget_final of 'Original & Final' budget column. Read pages 1-31 of 31
